identity.name: Rainberry Bay
identity.notes: Rainberry Bay is a 55+ gated community in Delray Beach, Florida (ZIP 33444, Palm Beach County), built between 1977 and 1989. It consists of approximately 901 residences (single-family and attached/townhouse), resale-only. The community features a clubhouse with theater and stage, outdoor pools, tennis courts, bocce ball courts, basketball courts, a fitness center, sauna, arts and crafts studio, and other resort-style amenities. An activity director is on site. A smaller sub-association called 'Rainberry BAY' (13 townhouse units) is tracked separately with a resident-verified HOA fee of $595/mo. Median closed sale price (Oct 2025 - Sep 2026) was $245,500 for 20 townhouses/villas; median asking price as of Oct 10, 2026 was $288,450 for 12 active listings.

fees.note: Resident-verified fee for the Rainberry BAY sub-association (13 townhouse units, Delray Beach FL 33444, Palm Beach County). Based on 1 data point from resident submissions and public records. Not a guaranteed fee; verify with the association directly. No special assessment signals reported yet. Leasing prohibited first 2 years; short-term rentals prohibited; rental approval requires application and buyer approval; pets allowed with number and size limits. Utilities: Electric - Florida Power & Light; Water/Sewer - City of Delray Beach Utilities; Trash - City of Delray Beach Sanitation Division (Solid Waste Authority of Palm Beach County). Manager on site. Internet included in HOA fee per resident-reported amenities. 0 reviews, 0 signals. Data combines public records and resident-submitted data; unverified data clearly marked.
